_help: Copy to perf.endpoints.json (same folder) and edit. Only used by the Performance page.
login: how the runner logs in per app before calling endpoints. Cookies (JSESSIONID) are kept automatically.
The body is sent as JSON (/Admin2/loginAction answers 415 to a form post); form: true posts it as an HTML form instead. failIf = regex on the redirect URL or page text that means the login failed.
token = dot path of the token in the JSON login response; it is then sent as <header>: <prefix><token>. Leave token out for cookie-only login.

${PERF_...} placeholders are replaced from environment variables: PERF_USER, PERF_PASS (admin), PERF_PORTAL_AGENCY, PERF_PORTAL_EMAIL, PERF_PORTAL_PASS (portal). start.ps1 -Perf asks for them. Never put passwords in this file.
params: sample values for path variables {id} and required @RequestParam by name, so more GET endpoints can be called.
endpoints: extra endpoints to time, including POST (e.g. airline search). These ARE called with the given body: use test data only.
The paths below are placeholders - replace them with the real ones from the controllers.
